name: Kaney
source:
Kaney (full name is Kaney Khaley) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change. Deceased before the beginning of the videogame's events.
The only source of Kaney's appearence is a monument after him at High Circles. It portrays Kaney as a presumably red-eyed bipedal om'verai, with cheeck and back fins, long paw spikes. Kaney's monument wears a white scarf.
Kaney is a legendary person, known for his handiness. However, some people call him "conceited".
